resolved_conflicts.explanation: Forest Lookouts gives 1910 for a lookout station; the Weirs Times gives 1911 for a 30-foot wood tower. The story reports both dates and does not choose between them, since no source says whether they describe the same beginning.

notes_for_editor: Start date disagrees across sources: Forest Lookouts gives a 1910 lookout station; the Weirs Times gives a 30-foot wood tower built 1911 and a 2,702 ft summit. Both are kept and not reconciled. Not used: a web search summary attributed a firelookout.org/lookouts/nh/signal.htm entry (2,673 ft, 37-ft structure, steel, NH Forestry as operator). That URL returned 404 on our fetch and its text was never read, so those details are omitted. The NHDFL forest lookout towers history PDF returned 403 to fetch_text and was not read; a search snippet mentions Timberland Owners funding for seven stations including Signal, but nothing rests on it. Owner, operator and staffing are unknown. A different Signal Mountain in Monroe (Grafton Co.) is a separate peak; a VFTT thread says it has no known lookout history (not cited). The forum visit reports are undated in the pages read and describe climbing. The story gives no route and advises against climbing. Pages read: FFLA NH list, Forest Lookouts page, Weirs article, two VFTT threads (the Millsfield one in part).
